cond_0001.intro: The ADC Chemistry (AC) group is seeking a creative synthetic chemist to develop novel payloads for antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). You will apply organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry to development of new anticancer therapies. You will work collaboratively within the chemistry department and with researchers across the biology, computational, and translational sciences to advance oncology therapeutics from concept to clinic. As an ADC Chemist, you will drive projects and new ideas through drug design, implementation of the synthetic routes, and generating structure-activity relationships and hypotheses.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Utilize experience and creativity in synthetic chemistry to advance ADC technology
Execute efficient routes for complex ADC payloads and drug linkers
Interpret SAR and prioritize compounds for in vitro and in vivo biology assessment
Contribute to and lead programs by executing lead optimization strategies and driving discovery goals
Effectively communicate and collaborate across a diverse research department to advance preclinical projects
Prepare patent applications and publish impactful research
Work cross-functionally with diverse teams to advance pre-clinical programs
Expand the capabilities of chemistry department by implementing new techniques and molecular design and implement cutting-edge technologies
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science OR M.S. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science with minimum 3 years related medicinal chemistry experience in the biopharmaceutical industry OR B.S. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science with minimum 5 years related medicinal chemistry experience in the biopharmaceutical industry
Contemporary knowledge of the key Medicinal Chemistry concepts and design tools required for pharmaceutical drug discovery
Excellent verbal and written communication
Preferred Requirements
Track record of accomplishment in chemical synthesis with examples of high impact publications from scientific work to date

cond_0015.intro: The ADC Chemistry group is looking for a synthetic chemist to develop novel payloads for antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). You will apply organic synthesis and medicinal chemistry to new anticancer therapies. A large part of the role involves working closely with researchers across chemistry, biology, computational, and translational sciences to advance oncology therapeutics from concept to clinic. You will regularly connect with colleagues across the department to drive projects and new ideas through drug design, synthetic route implementation, and structure-activity relationship development.

Execute efficient routes for complex ADC payloads and drug linkers
Interpret SAR and prioritize compounds for in vitro and in vivo biology assessment, communicating findings clearly to biology and translational teams
Contribute to and lead programs by executing lead optimization strategies and actively driving discovery goals
Stay in regular contact with a diverse research department to advance preclinical projects, speaking up to clarify priorities and resolve questions early
Prepare patent applications and publish impactful research
Work cross-functionally with diverse teams, initiating discussions to keep pre-clinical programs moving forward
Expand the capabilities of the chemistry department by implementing new techniques and molecular design and cutting-edge technologies

Contemporary knowledge of the key Medicinal Chemistry concepts and design tools required for pharmaceutical drug discovery
Excellent verbal and written communication, including comfort explaining trade-offs and walking colleagues through scientific decisions

You will work collaboratively within the chemistry department and with researchers across the biology, computational, and translational sciences to advance oncology therapeutics from concept to clinic. As an ADC Chemist, you will drive projects and new ideas through drug design, implementation of the synthetic routes, and generating structure-activity relationships and hypotheses.
cond_0082.responsibilities:
Utilize experience and creativity in synthetic chemistry to advance ADC technology
Execute efficient routes for complex ADC payloads and drug linkers
Interpret SAR and prioritize compounds for in vitro and in vivo biology assessment
Contribute to and lead programs by executing lead optimization strategies and driving discovery goals
Effectively communicate and collaborate across a diverse research department to advance preclinical projects
Prepare patent applications and publish impactful research
Work cross-functionally with diverse teams to advance pre-clinical programs
Expand the capabilities of chemistry department by implementing new techniques and molecular design and implement cutting-edge technologies
cond_0082.requirements:
Ph.D. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science OR
M.S. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science with minimum 3 years related medicinal chemistry experience in the biopharmaceutical industry OR
B.S. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science with minimum 5 years related medicinal chemistry experience in the biopharmaceutical industry
Contemporary knowledge of the key Medicinal Chemistry concepts and design tools required for pharmaceutical drug discovery
Excellent verbal and written communication
Track record of accomplishment in chemical synthesis with examples of high impact publications from scientific work to date
cond_0082.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

You will work collaboratively within the chemistry department and with researchers across the biology, computational, and translational sciences to advance oncology therapeutics from concept to clinic. As an ADC Chemist, you will drive projects and new ideas through drug design, implementation of synthetic routes, and generating structure-activity relationships and hypotheses. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of ADC chemistry and medicinal design.
cond_0364.responsibilities:
Utilize experience and creativity in synthetic chemistry to advance ADC technology
Execute efficient routes for complex ADC payloads and drug linkers
Interpret SAR and prioritize compounds for in vitro and in vivo biology assessment
Contribute to and lead programs by executing lead optimization strategies and driving discovery goals
Effectively communicate and collaborate across a diverse research department to advance preclinical projects
Prepare patent applications and publish impactful research
Work cross-functionally with diverse teams to advance pre-clinical programs
Expand the capabilities of chemistry department by implementing new techniques and molecular design and implement cutting-edge technologies
cond_0364.requirements:

Ph.D. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science OR M.S. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science with minimum 5 years related medicinal chemistry experience in the biopharmaceutical industry
Contemporary knowledge of the key Medicinal Chemistry concepts and design tools required for pharmaceutical drug discovery
Excellent verbal and written communication

Track record of accomplishment in chemical synthesis with examples of high impact publications from scientific work to date

You will work collaboratively within the chemistry department and with researchers across the biology, computational, and translational sciences to advance oncology therapeutics from concept to clinic. As an ADC Chemist, you will drive projects and new ideas through drug design, implementation of the synthetic routes, and generating structure-activity relationships and hypotheses. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of ADC chemistry and how synthetic decisions connect to biological outcomes.
cond_0391.responsibilities:
Utilize experience and creativity in synthetic chemistry to advance ADC technology
Execute efficient routes for complex ADC payloads and drug linkers
Interpret SAR and prioritize compounds for in vitro and in vivo biology assessment
Contribute to and lead programs by executing lead optimization strategies and driving discovery goals
Effectively communicate and collaborate across a diverse research department to advance preclinical projects
Prepare patent applications and publish impactful research
Work cross-functionally with diverse teams to advance pre-clinical programs
Expand the capabilities of chemistry department by implementing new techniques and molecular design and implement cutting-edge technologies
cond_0391.requirements:
Ph.D. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science OR
M.S. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science with minimum 3 years related medicinal chemistry experience in the biopharmaceutical industry OR
B.S. Degree in Organic/Medicinal Chemistry or related area of science with minimum 5 years related medicinal chemistry experience in the biopharmaceutical industry
Contemporary knowledge of the key Medicinal Chemistry concepts and design tools required for pharmaceutical drug discovery
Excellent verbal and written communication
Track record of accomplishment in chemical synthesis with examples of high impact publications from scientific work to date
cond_0391.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.
